Login rate limiting is an in-process fixed ten-attempt-per-minute-per-peer guard, now bounded to at most 4096 distinct peers with expired-window eviction; it is not a distributed or persisted limiter.
Trusted proxy forwarded host/scheme handling is peer allowlisted and only used for Origin same-origin evaluation; deployment still owns proxy/network configuration.

Traffic ingest/rollups are durable store APIs; no Agent traffic wire message exists in the frozen protocol implementation, so live Agent ingest remains unwired. Store ApplyTrafficDelta keeps the established metrics semantics: hourly rollups are durable regardless of detailed retention, per-delta history is opt-in.

Normal and force node deletion advance to COMPLETED through the controller watcher when the correlated node_decommission_ack durable inbox row arrives; the ACK wire is in the frozen agent protocol but no live agent wire is shipped in these artifacts.

Forward creation/PATCH preserve and validate frozen optional fields, but rate/stat changes are persisted desired-state fields not wired to live Agent session counters; disconnect_existing is accepted but not connected to live sessions.

Deployment profile (M1) has no independent route in the frozen OpenAPI; controller endpoint / private-site / secret visibility is delivered through the frozen /api/v1/settings surface. No non-frozen route was added; the disposition is recorded in repair_cycle_1.
Settings persistence is JSON+ETag-backed; private-site enforcement and full controller listen-address projection are not complete.
Traversal detection API records a pending API operation but does not execute/persist the full P12 detector profile; P14 restore/reauthorization surfaces have no invented frozen API routes.
No real CPE/router/WAN evidence; traversal capability stays at the prior real-daemon netns lab level.

repair_cycle_1.trigger: Two independent fresh-context reviews (spec/ownership + quality/security) returned REQUEST_CHANGES on H1-H8 (HIGH) and M1-M4 (MEDIUM) for the P15 candidate at 90b2c23. Bound repair per .hermes/plans/v1-beta/15-controller-api-metrics-sse.md and the P15 repair brief.

finding_to_fix.H1: Handoff self-consistency: P15.json recorded an obsolete head/tree (29306b9f/782280c2). The record now points at the repaired head a374148 / tree b9c7821d with base_sha=d335b09f, full canonical commits[]/files_changed[], and this repair_cycle_1 block.
finding_to_fix.H2: Traversal-defaults PUT on a fresh node compared the missing defaults revision 0 against the node revision and returned a permanent 412; a successful PUT returned the wrong {tcp,udp} schema. PutTraversalDefaults now treats a missing record like the node revision, commits the defaults upsert + parent node revision bump atomically (BEGIN IMMEDIATE + conditional WHERE), and the handler returns the full Node with a fresh ETag; stale expected maps to 412.
finding_to_fix.H3: Node deletion bypassed the P14 lifecycle (bare node_decommission outbox; force never created the terminal cleanup tombstone and never closed an ESTABLISHED session; App had no node watcher). (a) force delete now routes through lifecycle.ForceDeleteNode (tombstone + App-composed Hub.ForceCloseNodeSession + cleanup-guarded enqueue) and records the durable operation row; normal delete keeps the operation + outbox transaction and never quarantines. (b) App gains a node-deletion watcher that drains correlated node_decommission_ack rows and completes the operation/confirms the tombstone.
finding_to_fix.H4: Navigation category/item POST only validated the Idempotency-Key format. New CreateNavigationCategoryIdempotent/CreateNavigationItemIdempotent persist the durable idempotency record inside the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction (replay/conflict authority); the handlers return replayed responses unchanged and 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT for different-body reuse.
finding_to_fix.H5: listNodes/listForwards ignored page/page_size/sort/filter and always returned page=1 with total=len(items). New ListNodePage/ListForwardPage implement the frozen quota (sort by [+|-]field, filter field=value, total over the same predicate); unknown sort/filter fields return 400.
finding_to_fix.H6: ETag read-write races mapped stale writes to 500 instead of 412. PutNavigationOrder and PutSettingsRecord now do durable conditional (WHERE revision=...) writes; ApplyForwardDesired runs on BEGIN IMMEDIATE (matching ApplyForwardDelete) so a snapshot-upgrade race returns ErrCASConflict/412; traversal-defaults PUT got the same atomic treatment under H2; Forward PATCH parent-revision CAS was already in-transaction and is now on BEGIN IMMEDIATE.
finding_to_fix.H7: Force-publish changed only publication_state, left OPEN_FROM_VANTAGE/VERIFIED claiming a verified publication, and returned the stale pre-write snapshot. The handler now clears the verified axes (PUBLISHED_UNVERIFIED must never claim OPEN_FROM_VANTAGE per docs/state-model), validates the snapshot, persists, and re-reads fresh state for the 200.
finding_to_fix.H8: The durable bounded SSE handler was not composed. SSEHandler now has a MaxSubscribers gate (503 UNAVAILABLE beyond the cap) and a per-write deadline for slow clients; App composes it via api.RouterConfig.SSE and RegisterRoutes mounts the canonical handler on the frozen /api/v1/events route (fallback local poller only when no SSE is composed).
finding_to_fix.M1: No deployment-profile route exists in the frozen OpenAPI path list. Disposition: no non-frozen route was added; controller endpoint/private-site/secret visibility is delivered by the frozen /api/v1/settings GET (controller_endpoint is projected). store.GetDeploymentProfile/PutDeploymentProfile remain library-only. Recorded as a design-intent limitation.
finding_to_fix.M2: Review finding 'detailed disabled must not persist rollups' contradicts the P15-established metrics semantics (TestAccumulatorDisabledDetailedHistoryStillRollsUp: deltas opt-in, hourly rollups durable regardless). Reviewed & not applicable; the store behavior is unchanged and pinned by TestP15Repair1M2TrafficDetailedDisabledStillRollsUp.
finding_to_fix.M3: Login limiter peer map was unbounded. loginLimiter now caps at 4096 distinct peers with expired-window eviction; a brand-new peer beyond a saturated in-window map is refused fail-closed. (The review path attribution pointed at internal/forward/limiter.go, but the actual unbounded per-peer login map lives in internal/controller/api/auth.go; fixed there and documented.)
finding_to_fix.M4: The combined -race -count=10 gate exceeds the 10-minute budget in pre-existing store tests. Recorded honestly: api/web/metrics/forward passed full race x10; the store package timed out (running test at 8m: TestApplyForwardDesiredCommitsAll; candidate recorded TestR16Q2...). No DATA RACE. Focused P15 store race x10 passes in 29s. The timeout is the pre-existing suite-wide store runtime under full race x10, not a P15 defect.
